NDP_DANCER_BODY_OUTRO_FLAVOR.en: ..and so you beat the game with a borken unfinished character ur not even good lol i havent finished the lore because you dont deserver it
NDP_DANCER_BODY_OUTRO_FLAVOR.zh-TW: ……於是你用一個壞掉又沒做完的角色破關了，你根本就不強好嗎笑死，背景故事我還沒寫完，因為你不配看

KEYWORD_DANCER_CANCELS.en: Sprinting <style=cIsUtility>cancels</style> Jabs into a Dash Attack. Jumping <style=cIsUtility>cancels</style> ground moves into aerials.
KEYWORD_DANCER_CANCELS.zh-TW: 奔跑可將刺擊<style=cIsUtility>取消</style>為衝刺攻擊。跳躍可將地面招式<style=cIsUtility>取消</style>為空中攻擊。

KEYWORD_DANCER_JAB.en: <style=cKeywordName>Jab</style> <style=cIsUtility>Input: ground, aim forward.</style> <style=cSub>Dash forward and deal <style=cIsDamage>180%</style> damage
KEYWORD_DANCER_JAB.zh-TW: <style=cKeywordName>刺擊</style> <style=cIsUtility>輸入：地面，向前瞄準。</style> <style=cSub>向前衝刺並造成<style=cIsDamage>180%</style>傷害

KEYWORD_DANCER_DASH.en: <style=cKeywordName>Dash Attack</style> <style=cIsUtility>Input: ground, sprinting.</style> <style=cSub>Dash forward, interrupt enemies and deal <style=cIsDamage>250%</style> damage.
KEYWORD_DANCER_DASH.zh-TW: <style=cKeywordName>衝刺攻擊</style> <style=cIsUtility>輸入：地面，奔跑中。</style> <style=cSub>向前衝刺，打斷敵人並造成<style=cIsDamage>250%</style>傷害。

KEYWORD_DANCER_DOWNTILT.en: <style=cKeywordName>Down Tilt</style> <style=cIsUtility>Input: ground, aim down.</style> <style=cSub>Knock enemies upwards and deal <style=cIsDamage>200%</style> damage.</style>
KEYWORD_DANCER_DOWNTILT.zh-TW: <style=cKeywordName>下強攻擊</style> <style=cIsUtility>輸入：地面，向下瞄準。</style> <style=cSub>將敵人向上擊飛並造成<style=cIsDamage>200%</style>傷害。</style>

KEYWORD_DANCER_UPAIR.en: <style=cKeywordName>Up Air</style> <style=cIsUtility>Input: aim up.</style> <style=cSub>Two attacks that deal <style=cIsDamage>150%</style> and <style=cIsDamage>200%</style> damage. Second attack is narrow and deals up to <style=cIsDamage>3x</style> damage to low health enemies.</style>
KEYWORD_DANCER_UPAIR.zh-TW: <style=cKeywordName>上空中攻擊</style> <style=cIsUtility>輸入：向上瞄準。</style> <style=cSub>兩段攻擊，分別造成<style=cIsDamage>150%</style>與<style=cIsDamage>200%</style>傷害。第二段攻擊範圍狹窄，對生命值較低的敵人最多造成<style=cIsDamage>3x</style>傷害。</style>

KEYWORD_DANCER_FORWARDAIR.en: <style=cKeywordName>Forward Air</style> <style=cIsUtility>Input: air, aim forward.</style> <style=cSub>Heavy swing that deals <style=cIsDamage>180%</style> damage and spikes enemies to the ground, <style=cIsDamage>stunning</style> and dealing up to <style=cIsDamage>300%</style> damage</style>
KEYWORD_DANCER_FORWARDAIR.zh-TW: <style=cKeywordName>前空中攻擊</style> <style=cIsUtility>輸入：空中，向前瞄準。</style> <style=cSub>沉重的揮擊，造成<style=cIsDamage>180%</style>傷害並將敵人砸向地面，使其<style=cIsDamage>眩暈</style>並造成最多<style=cIsDamage>300%</style>傷害。</style>

KEYWORD_DANCER_DOWNAIR.en: <style=cKeywordName>Down Air</style> <style=cIsUtility>Input: air, aim down.</style> <style=cSub>Dive downwards and repeatedly deal <style=cIsDamage>125%</style> damage. If you hit the ground, start a <style=cIsDamage>Down Tilt</style></style>
KEYWORD_DANCER_DOWNAIR.zh-TW: <style=cKeywordName>下空中攻擊</style> <style=cIsUtility>輸入：空中，向下瞄準。</style> <style=cSub>向下俯衝，反覆造成<style=cIsDamage>125%</style>傷害。落地時會接著施展<style=cIsDamage>下強攻擊</style>。</style>

NDP_DANCER_BODY_PRIMARY_SLASH_DESCRIPTIO.en: <style=cIsDamage>Melee attack</style> with effects based on your aim input. <style=cIsUtility>(Hover for more details)</style>
NDP_DANCER_BODY_PRIMARY_SLASH_DESCRIPTIO.zh-TW: <style=cIsDamage>近戰攻擊</style>，效果取決於你的瞄準輸入。<style=cIsUtility>（將滑鼠移到這裡查看詳情）</style>

KEYWORD_DANCER_INPUTS.en: <style=cKeywordName>Inputs</style> <style=cSub>Movement Direction, Sprint, and Jump have input attacks. Some inputs have different attacks if pressed repeatedly. ill make a better explanation soon sry.
KEYWORD_DANCER_INPUTS.zh-TW: <style=cKeywordName>輸入</style> <style=cSub>移動方向、奔跑與跳躍都有對應的輸入攻擊。部分輸入連續按下時會使出不同的攻擊。我之後會寫個更好的說明，抱歉啦。

NDP_DANCER_BODY_PRIMARY_SLASH2_DESCRIPTI.en: Hold to turn your <style=cIsUtility>movement inputs</style> into <style=cIsDamage>melee attacks</style>. <style=cIsUtility>(Hover for more details)</style>
NDP_DANCER_BODY_PRIMARY_SLASH2_DESCRIPTI.zh-TW: 按住時，<style=cIsUtility>移動輸入</style>會變成<style=cIsDamage>近戰攻擊</style>。<style=cIsUtility>（將滑鼠移到這裡查看詳情）</style>

NDP_DANCER_BODY_SECONDARY_SLASH_DESCRIPT.en: Dash in a target direction and strike <style=cIsDamage>3</style> times, each dealing <style=cIsDamage>250% damage</style>.
NDP_DANCER_BODY_SECONDARY_SLASH_DESCRIPT.zh-TW: 朝目標方向衝刺並攻擊<style=cIsDamage>3</style>次，每次造成<style=cIsDamage>250%傷害</style>。

NDP_DANCER_BODY_UTILITY_PULL_DESCRIPTION.en: Extend your lance, dealing <style=cIsDamage>550% damage</style>. Hold to <style=cIsUtility>pull</style> yourself and enemies to the tip. <style=cIsUtility>Jump</style> to exit early
NDP_DANCER_BODY_UTILITY_PULL_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 伸長你的長槍，造成<style=cIsDamage>550%傷害</style>。按住可將自己與敵人<style=cIsUtility>拉</style>向槍尖。<style=cIsUtility>跳躍</style>可提早結束。

NDP_DANCER_BODY_UTILITY_DRILL_DESCRIPTIO.en: Lunge horizontally, dealing <style=cIsDamage>3x180% damage</style>, then start a <style=cIsDamage>Down Tilt.</style> Can store up two <style=cIsUtility>2</style> charges.
NDP_DANCER_BODY_UTILITY_DRILL_DESCRIPTIO.zh-TW: 水平突進，造成<style=cIsDamage>3x180%傷害</style>，接著施展<style=cIsDamage>下強攻擊。</style>最多可儲存<style=cIsUtility>2</style>次充能。

KEYWORD_DANCER_RIBBON.en: <color=#611221><style=cKeywordName>Ribbon</style></color><style=cSub>Ribboned enemies bleed for <style=cIsDamage>0%</style> damage per second and are <style=cIsDamage>unable to act.</style>
KEYWORD_DANCER_RIBBON.zh-TW: <color=#611221><style=cKeywordName>緞帶</style></color><style=cSub>被緞帶纏住的敵人每秒流血，受到<style=cIsDamage>0%</style>傷害，且<style=cIsDamage>無法行動。</style>

NDP_DANCER_BODY_SPECIAL_RIBBON_DESCRIPTI.en: <style=cIsDamage>Stunning.</style> Fire a projectile that <color=#b50727>ribbons</color> enemies for <style=cIsDamage>8</style> seconds. Attacking <color=#b50727>ribboned</color> enemies grants a <style=cIsHealing>temporary barrier</style> and <style=cIsDamage>extends</style> the ribbon.
NDP_DANCER_BODY_SPECIAL_RIBBON_DESCRIPTI.zh-TW: <style=cIsDamage>眩暈。</style>發射一枚投射物，以<color=#b50727>緞帶</color>纏住敵人<style=cIsDamage>8</style>秒。攻擊被<color=#b50727>緞帶纏住</color>的敵人可獲得<style=cIsHealing>臨時屏障</style>，並<style=cIsDamage>延長</style>緞帶的持續時間。

NDP_DANCER_BODY_DANCER_RESCUEMAGE_ACHIEV.en: As Dancer, successfully recover the lost ENV Suit
NDP_DANCER_BODY_DANCER_RESCUEMAGE_ACHIEV.zh-TW: 作為舞者，成功找回遺失的環境防護服。
